title: Min Cost to Connect All Points (Prim's MST)

monster.name: Magnetic Colossus
monster.title: Forging Minimum Spanning Networks
monster.defeatQuote: Minimum Manhattan spanning tree constructed across all coordinates!

description: You are given an array `points` representing integer coordinates of some points on a 2D-plane, where `points[i] = [xi, yi]`. The cost of connecting two points `[xi, yi]` and `[xj, yj]` is the Manhattan distance: `|xi - xj| + |yi - yj|`. Return the minimum cost to make all points connected.
solutionCode:
def minCostConnectPoints(points: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    n = len(points)
    import heapq
    visited = [False] * n
    pq = [(0, 0)]
    total_cost = 0
    connected = 0
    while pq and connected < n:
        cost, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if visited[u]: continue
        visited[u] = True
        total_cost += cost
        connected += 1
        x1, y1 = points[u]
        for v in range(n):
            if not visited[v]:
                x2, y2 = points[v]
                heapq.heappush(pq, (abs(x1 - x2) + abs(y1 - y2), v))
    return total_cost
hints: Prim's or Kruskal's algorithm on complete graph with Manhattan weights.
